stories.title: Human-caused wildfire forces 42,000 from Reno area
new_facts: Fire is zero percent contained.
45,000 additional residents placed on evacuation alert.

stories.title: Counterfeit peptide causes acute liver damage in another user
new_facts: Seventh case of liver toxicity in Victoria linked to counterfeit peptides; doctors suspect contaminated batch.
stories.line: A person using counterfeit peptides developed acute liver damage, adding to a pattern of injuries from fake compounds sold online.

stories.line: An OpenAI researcher who left for a startup rejoins the AI competition by moving to Meta's new superintelligence unit.

stories.title: Luxury brands enter resale market as secondhand sales surge
new_facts: The RealReal's 2026 resale report highlights rising consumer specificity and savviness in luxury resale market.
stories.line: Luxury resale marketplaces are reshaping how high-end goods move, with retailers and brands now competing in a secondhand market once considered beneath them.

stories.title: Tech giants push unproven AI into schools amid resistance
stories.line: Tech companies are placing AI tools in schools with limited evidence of benefit, using influence and resources to shape curriculum.
